title: WINGNUT – 16-Bit Shmup (Early Access OUT NOW)
author: Comet7777
selftext:
About 3 weeks of heads down work with Claude and other tools got me to get to the point of pushing this out there for Early Access (will push to Steam once my account stuff is all approved by them).

AI game dev has totally changed my free time for the better. It's not even about making sales, but just have a creative outlet and enjoying the building and iteration process. I'm tossing this out here in the event it catches anyone's attention OR if anyone has questions. Happy to chat through this process!
